description: Questions about the sample documents in sample-docs/. 'documents': files that contain the answer (the handbook contains every policy, so it is always accepted). 'text': a regular expression that must appear in one of the passages the search finds. 'facts': regular expressions that must appear in the written answer. No 'documents' = the documents do not contain the answer.
